messages.subject: Events in ShinyR
parts:
Hi all, 

I have a couple of related questions about events/messages in ShinyR 
First, simplest questions - are datatable events available, ie. https://www.datatables.net/reference/event 

Secondly, is there any way to create your own event/message bus? I've created one as a selectInput (using updateSelectInput) for now, and I need it to collate the events from multiple ggvis scatterplot selections. 

Cheers!

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Events in ShinyR
parts:
Hi Andrew,

1. I'm not sure what you meant by "available", but you can certainly
use these DataTables events, e.g. through the `callback` argument of
DT::datatable() (like callback = JS("table.on('draw.dt',
function(event) {})"); see more info at http://rstudio.github.io/DT/)

2. It might be related to some of our recent work in progress. Please
take a look at the documentation here
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/pull/935/files?short_path=36e8a69#diff-36e8a6943c0ca56eb1231883cfd3dd79
(Again, this is still work in progress and you need the development
version of shiny https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/; please test it if
it looks relevant to what you want to do)

Regards,
Yihui
